sources.title: 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey: AI
sources.version_notes: The audit uses the named 2025 survey page.

evidence.quote: 84% of respondents are using or planning to use AI tools in their development process, an increase over last year (76%).
evidence.locator: Section 3.1, AI tools in the development process
evidence.note: The claim preserves the population and the use-or-plan-to-use qualification.

evidence.quote: More developers actively distrust the accuracy of AI tools (46%) than trust it (33%).
evidence.note: The report reverses the direction of the published comparison.

evidence.quote: AI agents are not yet mainstream. A majority of developers (52%) either don't use agents or stick to simpler AI tools.
evidence.note: Universal adoption is much stronger than the survey supports.
